scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:library
scripts.build:library: npm run transform-icons && npm run compile && npm run copy-library-assets
scripts.clean: npx rimraf ./dist && npx rimraf ./svg-icons/build && npx rimraf ./svg-icons/indes.ts
scripts.build:showcase: npm run build:library && npm run bundle-showcase && npm run copy-showcase-files
scripts.copy-showcase-files: cpx showcase/index.html dist/showcase && cpx showcase/styles.css dist/showcase
scripts.copy-library-assets: cpx svg-icons dist && cpx README.md dist && cpx package.json dist
